Compute a 2-D (or n-D) embedding of a samples x features matrix

Source: R/embedding.R
compute_embedding.Rd

A thin, consistent wrapper around PCA (stats::prcomp()), UMAP (uwot::umap()) and t-SNE (Rtsne::Rtsne()) with sensible defaults for the small sample sizes typical of multi-omics studies.

Usage

compute_embedding(
  x,
  type = c("umap", "tsne", "pca"),
  n_components = 2,
  scale = FALSE,
  n_neighbors = NULL,
  min_dist = 0.1,
  perplexity = NULL,
  seed = 21,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

Numeric matrix, samples x features (e.g. factor scores).

type

One of "umap", "tsne" or "pca".

n_components

Number of output dimensions (default 2).

scale

Logical. Standardise columns before embedding (default FALSE, which keeps each factor's own variance).

n_neighbors

UMAP neighbourhood size. Default min(15, n_samples - 1).

min_dist

UMAP min_dist (default 0.1).

perplexity

t-SNE perplexity. Default chosen from the sample size (at most 30, and below (n_samples - 1) / 3).

seed

Random seed (default 21).

...

Further arguments passed to uwot::umap() or Rtsne::Rtsne().

Value

A data frame with a sample column and Dim1, Dim2, ...

Examples

sim <- simulate_multiomics(n_samples = 40, seed = 1)
x <- t(do.call(rbind, sim$data))
head(compute_embedding(x, "pca"))
#>   sample       Dim1       Dim2
#> 1   S001 -18.492770  10.975741
#> 2   S002   1.748707 -25.579452
#> 3   S003  34.324237   7.862819
#> 4   S004 -47.844100  13.332657
#> 5   S005   2.307836 -17.974998
#> 6   S006  42.956048  19.336523
